newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end stable, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end stable, seen falling.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed stable on Wednesday as liquidity remained relatively balanced in the banking system, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 6.346 percent against Tuesday's 6.340 close, with 30-day commercial paper steady at 6.30-6.35 against 6.35-6.40.
Dealers saw room for the money rates to fall on Thursday on loosening funds.
The benchmark bond yields fell in early session, but trading interest was thin in the afternoon.
